title: Turkish Residence Permit (Ikamet) 2026: Tourist, Property & Closed Districts
metaDescription: Understand the turkey residence permit 2026 rules: $200,000 property threshold, closed neighborhood updates, required documents, and renewal steps.
quickAnswer: Applying for a turkey residence permit 2026 under [Law No. 6458](https://en.goc.gov.tr/residence-permit-types) requires filing online via e-İkamet before your visa expires, carrying valid Turkish health insurance, and registering a verifiable address. Property-based permits require a residential deed worth $200,000+ USD (for post-October 2023 purchases), while tourist permits face strict travel-plan and solvency checks.
category: Real Estate, Investment, Citizenship & Relocation (ITO Advisory)

body.text: What is the $200,000 minimum property value rule for a property residence permit?

For residential properties bought on or after [16 October 2023](https://tenha.av.tr/turkey-property-residence-200k-deed-rule/), the [Presidency of Migration Management](https://en.goc.gov.tr/general-information41) requires an official value of at least $200,000 USD in Turkish Lira equivalent to qualify for a property-based short-term residence permit. The unit must be zoned residential (konut) with the full value declared on the TAPU.

Homes bought below $200,000 USD after that date do not qualify for property-based Ikamet. Separately, Turkish authorities introduced a [financial-investment residency route in November 2026](https://aslanattorney.com/turkeys-new-investor-residence-permit-three-or-five-years/) ($150,000 for 3 years or $200,000 for 5 years in qualifying financial assets). Before buying real estate for residency, review our [SPK appraisal and TAPU verification guide](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/tapu-verification-turkey).
Which Istanbul and Antalya neighborhoods are currently closed to new foreign Ikamet registrations?

In 2022, the [Presidency of Migration Management](https://en.goc.gov.tr/residence-1) closed 1,169 neighborhoods where foreign residents exceeded 20%, including Fatih, Esenyurt, and parts of Beyoğlu, Şişli, Başakşehir, Konyaaltı, and Alanya. In [June 2026, administrative practice shifted](https://residencepermitinturkey.com/districts-closed-to-residence-permit.html), and many previously restricted Istanbul and [Alanya neighborhoods began accepting applications again](https://newtimeinvestment.com/en/news/residence-permit-restrictions-lifted-alanya-2026).

Because no permanent legislative repeal was published, provincial offices can tighten quotas again without long notice. Always have a licensed immigration lawyer confirm live address eligibility in e-İkamet before signing a lease or deed.

body.text: What documents (health insurance, address registration, biometrics) are required?

Applicants must submit a signed e-İkamet form, a passport valid 60+ days beyond the requested permit, four recent biometric photos, qualifying Turkish private health insurance, verifiable address registration, financial proof, and fee receipts. The 2026 [residence card fee is 964 TRY](https://bayraktarattys.com/residence-permit-renewal-turkey), plus nationality-based fees set by [Göç İdaresi](https://en.goc.gov.tr/documents-for-residence-permit-fee-amount).
Prepare this document checklist before your migration office appointment:

items: Passport & Entry Copies: Original passport plus copies of photo page and latest entry stamp (60+ days validity past permit end).
Private Health Insurance: Policy from a Turkish-licensed insurer covering the full permit period.
Address Proof: Official TAPU copy or notarized rental contract, plus civil registry address confirmation (Yerleşim Yeri Belgesi) for renewals.
Biometrics & Tax ID: Four 4×6 cm biometric photos and your [Turkish Potential Tax ID](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/open-bank-account-turkey-foreigners) for fee payments.

UETS Electronic Notification Address: Required for renewals so authorities deliver official notices digitally, per [Turkish immigration counsel](https://batinyilmaz.av.tr/en/ikamet-izni-uzatma-basvurusu/).

body.text: How does renewal work and what changed for tourist Ikamet?

Renewal applications open exactly [60 days before your current Ikamet card expires](https://bayraktarattys.com/residence-permit-renewal-turkey) through the official [e-İkamet portal](https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/investmentguide/pages/obtaining-a-residence-permit.aspx), and you must file before the expiry date. Your stamped application receipt permits lawful stay during review, and the renewed permit runs continuously from your previous card's expiry date.

For tourist Ikamet, the category remains in [Law No. 6458 in 2026](https://batinyilmaz.av.tr/en/turizm-ikamet-izni/), but automatic approvals have ended. Migration officers closely examine travel itineraries, bank solvency (benchmarked to the Turkish minimum wage), notarized leases, and prior stay history. For long-term stays, property, work, student, or family permits are far more predictable.

faq.q: Is the $200,000 property rule still in effect for a Turkish residence permit in 2026?
faq.a: Yes. Residential properties bought on or after 16 October 2023 must meet the [$200,000 USD](https://tenha.av.tr/turkey-property-residence-200k-deed-rule/) official value threshold for property-based Ikamet.

faq.q: Are closed neighborhoods in Istanbul and Antalya reopened in 2026?
faq.a: Administrative practice [eased in June 2026](https://residencepermitinturkey.com/districts-closed-to-residence-permit.html), allowing applications in many formerly restricted areas, but always verify your exact address in e-İkamet first.

faq.q: When can I apply to renew my Turkish Ikamet?
faq.a: File online via e-İkamet starting [60 days before your current card expires](https://bayraktarattys.com/residence-permit-renewal-turkey), and strictly before the expiration date.

faq.q: What is the UETS address required for residence permit renewals?
faq.a: UETS (Ulusal Elektronik Tebligat Sistemi) is Türkiye's national electronic notification address, obtained via PTT or e-Devlet, used for official migration notices.

faq.q: Has the tourist residence permit been abolished in 2026?
faq.a: No, it remains in [Law No. 6458](https://batinyilmaz.av.tr/en/turizm-ikamet-izni/), though migration offices strictly scrutinize finances, leases, and genuine tourism plans.

faq.q: Can Itinerary of Türkiye file my Ikamet application for me?
faq.a: No. Itinerary of Türkiye coordinates on-the-ground visits and independent introductions; residence applications and legal filings remain with you or a licensed Turkish attorney.
